name: Households with a broadband subscription
source: Census Reporter API, ACS 2024 1-year table B28002, Monterey County row; underlying estimates are U.S. Census Bureau ACS
notes: ACS table B28002 universe is households. The estimate for B28002004 ('Broadband of any type') is 123,233 (MOE 2,259) out of B28002001 total households 132,591 (MOE 1,848): 123,233 ÷ 132,591 × 100 = 92.94%, rounded to 92.9%. This is a single-year ACS 2024 1-year estimate, GEOID 05000US06053. County/local sources did not provide an accessible newer countywide figure; the direct Census API was unavailable, so Census Reporter is classified tier 3.
